(the target states this check without the page's condition, which is harmless here because the user already has full bars); 'Tap Wi-Fi again and make sure Connectivity Assist is off.'; 'If the Wi-Fi setting appears dimmed (grayed out), restart your device.'; 'If you still see a message like No Internet Connection, there might be another issue. Page read. It is for Android devices and says 'Depending on your device, these options may be different.' This is an Android distractor for an iPhone user, so it does not apply here and is correctly unused.

required_actions.action: Open the Settings app
Confirm Wi-Fi is turned on (the user's full bars already show this; the Wi-Fi screen is still needed to reach Connectivity Assist)
Look for the blue checkmark that confirms the connection
Confirm Airplane Mode is off
Confirm Connectivity Assist is off
Restart the device if the Wi-Fi setting is dimmed
Check the router and network settings if No Internet Connection still shows
Tap the network name to join (already done: the user is connected and has full bars)

source_checks.finding: Page read. It is for Android devices and says labels vary by device. The page's exact words differ from the excerpt: 'Look for a data indicator, such as "2G, 3G, 4G, or H," next to the signal bars.' The page also says that on some devices you may need to select Data usage first; to enable mobile data, and to turn it off and back on if it is already on; that the indicator may not show if Wi-Fi is active, so turn Wi-Fi off and check again; and that with no indicator you should move somewhere else or go outside and check again. The General troubleshooting tips section, step 1, says 'Restart your device,' which supports the earlier assistant turn.

required_actions.action: Turn the mobile data switch on (the user says it is off)
Look for a data indicator beside the signal bars
If Wi-Fi is active, turn Wi-Fi off and check again
If no data indicator appears, move somewhere else or go outside, then check again
If problems continue or happen often, contact the mobile service provider

findings: Step 5 adds the condition 'and you can', which the page does not say. The page says: 'If there's no data indicator, you may be in an area with no coverage. Move somewhere else or go outside.' The added condition could stop a user who cannot move from acting at all.
correction_required: Change step 5 to: 'If no data indicator appears, move to a different area or go outside, then check again.' Keep the closing sentence about contacting the mobile service provider unchanged.
